welcome.label: Welcome · 9:41 PM

parts.label: 🔎 The case question
parts.title: What happened on the pier?
parts.body: Nobody touched anything. So how did energy reach all four sensors at once?

welcome.script:
(Flick the classroom light off, then on.) Did you notice that? Something changed, and nobody touched you.

[ON SCREEN: Sam’s strip chart]
Last night, all four of Sam’s sensors on the pier jumped at the same moment. Then the lamp went dark.

[ON SCREEN: The case question]
But nobody was there! Let’s find out how. Press Listen on Sam’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · feel it, rate it (Clue 1)

parts.label: 🙌 Do it with me
parts.title: You are the source
rows: Rub your hands, then touch your cheeks
Hum with fingers on your throat
Cover your eyes, then look at a light

warmup.script:
(Rub your hands together fast, then press them on your cheeks.) Ooh, warm! Where did that warmth go?

[ON SCREEN: Do it with me]
Rub your hands with me. Now hum with your fingers on your throat. Feel the buzz? You are the energy source today! Do all three moves, rate each one, then pick where the energy went. Press Listen.

part1.label: Part 1 · block the path (Clue 2)
part1.script:
(Hold your hand near a warm mug without touching it.) I’m not touching it, but my hand feels warm. How?

[ON SCREEN: Block the path]
Tap each gap and see what’s in there. Then block it and watch the receiver. If blocking it stops the change, energy was traveling through that gap. Press Listen.

part2.label: Part 2 · which way does heat go? (Clue 3)

parts.label: 🌡️ Which way does heat go?
parts.title: Iced lemonade on a hot porch
parts.body: Does heat move IN, or does cold move OUT? Pick an arrow, then wait one hour.

part2.script:
(Hold an ice cube or a cold can.) My hand feels cold. Is cold moving into my hand?

[ON SCREEN: Which way does heat go?]
Pick your arrow, then watch the thermometers. Press Listen.

explore.label: Part 4 · storm watch (Clue 4)
explore.script:
(Clap once, then wait, then stomp.) Flash… one, two, three… BOOM!

[ON SCREEN: A real Florida storm]
These are real lightning photos from Kennedy Space Center, here in Florida.

[ON SCREEN: Count with me]
Tap when you see the flash and again when you hear the boom. The gap tells you how far away it hit. Turn your sound on and press Listen.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: What happened at 9:41 PM?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You have four clues. Crack the case at the top of this tab.

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Then write your case report: two short answers, your energy hunt and your CER. For the hunt, find one heat, light, sound and electrical example at home. Press Listen.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “Energy can’t really move through the air. You have to TOUCH things to transfer energy.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The claim]
Do you have to touch something to get its energy? Hmm. Think about the campfire, the Sun and the thunder.

There’s no wrong side, as long as you prove it.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts, then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…” Press Listen.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 💡 Your specimen
parts.title: The burnt-out pier bulb
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ➡ Next time
parts.title: Energy stations
parts.body: Set up four stations and collect your own evidence.

closing.script:
[ON SCREEN: What really happened]
Case closed! Lightning hit the metal lamp post, and its energy reached every sensor through the air.

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and the burnt-out pier bulb goes in your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Next time]
Next time, you set up energy stations and collect your own evidence. Press Listen for Sam’s last word.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
